description: This file 'maf.h' is a header file defining interfaces for working with a MAF (Mass Air Flow) sensor system, including function declarations, macros, and external dependencies related to MAF sensor readings and configurations.

methods.name: getMaf
methods.description: Retrieves the current MAF sensor reading as a float value.

methods.name: hasMafSensor
methods.description: Checks if a MAF sensor is present and available.

methods.name: getRealMaf
methods.description: Returns the actual MAF sensor value, possibly after calibration or processing.

methods.name: setBosch0280218037
methods.description: Configures engine settings for a specific Bosch sensor variant.

methods.name: setBosch0280218004
methods.description: Configures engine settings for another Bosch sensor variant.

methods.name: setDensoTODO
methods.description: Configures engine for a Denso sensor, implementation likely pending.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNAMaf
methods.description: Configures settings for a Mazda Miata with a N/A MAF sensor.
